scope: Public website and appointment-request page; the booking observation concerns one desktop-browser review session.

metrics.label: Website-displayed Google rating
metrics.context: Displayed by the hospital site; the current Google listing and review count were not independently checked.

observations.title: Check booking resilience and the fallback path
observations.observed: In one desktop-browser session and after reload, the appointment page showed its heading, phone fallback and illustration, but no scheduling fields or calendar controls.
observations.improvement: Recheck ordinary browsers and blocked-script conditions. If a scheduler is intended, keep a direct booking link or clearly labelled phone fallback visible.

observations.title: Date time-sensitive homepage notices clearly
observations.observed: A time-sensitive homepage news excerpt says "as of June 17" without a year in that excerpt; it links separately to the news article.
observations.improvement: Add a full date beside time-sensitive excerpts. Assign a review owner and label historical notices; this does not assess clinical accuracy.

sources.label: Homepage / displayed rating and news excerpt

limitations: The booking result is specific to one browser session. Its cause and customer impact are unknown; it does not establish a sitewide booking failure.
No client app or scheduler was authenticated or submitted. Clinical accuracy and treatment advice were outside scope.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
